lead: Static pages shown outside the blog. The URL is the page's public address.
pick: Pick a page or create a new one.

field.title: Title
field.registrationRequired: Only signed-in members can read it (guests get 401 and a sign-in prompt)

errors.url: Use only letters, digits, “-”, “_”, “.”, “~” and “/”, and not an empty path.
errors.title: The title must be 1 to 200 characters.
errors.taken: “{url}” is already used by another page.

delete.title: Delete page {url}?
delete.body: The URL will return a missing-page answer.

history.title: Revision history
history.loaded: Loaded the old values of revision {time}; not saved yet.
history.note: There is no separate restore API: “Load old values” only fills the form; press “Save page” to apply.
history.empty: This page has no edits yet.

preview.title: Preview (blog style, sanitised)
preview.pausedWait: More than 60 previews a minute, so the server refused (429). The last preview stays; type again after {seconds} seconds to update it. Saving the page still works.
preview.paused: More than 60 previews a minute, so the server refused (429). The last preview stays; type again to update it. Saving the page still works.
preview.hint: Updates 0.5 seconds after the last key, with the same sanitiser as saving.
